images.description: Illustration of a Scout with a backpack looking out at a mountain trail, excited to start hiking
Historical illustration or painting of early American explorers walking through rugged wilderness with heavy packs — contrast with the modern hiking scene
Scouts hiking along a desert trail at sunrise with red rock mesas in the background, wide-brimmed hats and hydration packs visible
A Scout's handwritten trip plan on a clipboard, with a map and pencil beside it on a picnic table
A layering system demonstration showing base layer, mid layer, and outer shell laid out on a flat surface
A Scout pausing on a trail to read a map and compass, with forest in the background
An open first-aid kit on a rock with bandages, moleskin, and antiseptic wipes visible — trail setting
A Scout wrapped in an emergency blanket being helped by a buddy on a cold, misty trail
Close-up of a properly wrapped ankle with an elastic bandage, demonstrating the compression step of RICE
A group of Scouts hiking single-file on a well-maintained forest trail, demonstrating proper trail etiquette
A Scout hiking at dusk with a headlamp illuminating the trail ahead, red light setting visible
Three types of hiking footwear side by side on a log — hiking boots, trail runners, and approach shoes
A trail sign at a wilderness boundary showing Leave No Trace principles posted on a wooden kiosk
A Scout picking up a piece of trail litter and placing it in a small trash bag attached to their pack
A Scout observing a deer through binoculars from a safe distance on a mountain meadow trail
A Scout standing at a scenic overlook, looking out at a pristine wilderness valley — embodying stewardship
A compact backpacking stove heating water on a flat rock, with no fire ring or scorched ground visible
A Scout jogging on a trail with a daypack, mid-stride, demonstrating aerobic activity in a natural setting
A weekly training calendar pinned to a bulletin board with hiking distances and cross-training activities written in
A trail lunch spread on a bandana — trail mix, jerky, an energy bar, a water bottle, and an orange — on a flat rock
A topographic map spread on a table with a highlighted 10-mile route, compass, and pencil beside it
A well-packed trail lunch in a zip-lock bag — wraps, trail mix, jerky, and an energy bar visible
Two Scouts high-fiving at a trail marker showing 'Mile 20' with a mountain vista in the background
A Scout sitting on a log writing in a small notebook, backpack beside them, forest trail in the background
A close-up of a hand-drawn trail map in a notebook with colored pencil annotations marking wildlife sightings and scenic spots
An open scrapbook-style hike report with photos, pressed leaves, and handwritten notes on a desk
Four types of hiking footwear arranged in a row — trail runners, hiking shoes, hiking boots, and mountaineering boots — on a wooden deck
A panoramic view of the Appalachian Trail winding through misty green mountains in the Blue Ridge
